original.target_description: Relationship between disaffected behavior in the Fall and emotional engagement in Spring. Student self-report, Grades 4–7; multiple regression of spring outcome on fall predictor controlling fall outcome; Figure 4.

n.sample_role: students; study sample 123, but target regression analytic n not explicitly established

notes:
Replication full text verified by title, authors and DOI in body despite incorrectly labeled ResearchGate landing metadata. Figure 2 coefficients are graphical and absent from accessible text parse; no coefficient or numeric p inferred from narrative significance. Original ns label preserved without deriving a numeric bound. Replication 123 is a study sample, not assumed to equal analytic n.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly compare the named relationship with Skinner et al.; narrative verdict is failed.
Completion source review (n_o): Directly printed final analysis sample of 805 children selected for less than 5% missing data and imputed; the target is the Figure 4 participant-level fall-to-spring regression. Recruitment/contributor counts 1,242 children and 53 teachers are separate roles.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Both bottom-panel paths into spring emotional engagement have two stars (.10** and -.10**), and the legend gives p < .01. The target bound is invariant to the unresolved predictor-label placement; no coefficient chosen from row order.
